title: Layer 3 round 1 minor collector SE: segment arithmetic — the open-count split lacks digit-exactness, the fit budget invariant breaks at saturation, the layer suffix is the first truncation casualty

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in ff331dd9: split_open_count is digit-exact (mirroring the acquisition's strip — '(kept open)' and '(many open)' stay names, unit-pinned); fit() preserves its budget invariant at degenerate budgets via hard cuts, never overflow; the phase field's layer suffix is a protected tail truncating the name first (the #680 order generalized through one fit path).
